name: adversarial_ensemble_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: This meta-strategy runs 5 sub-strategies simultaneously (VWAP mean reversion, ORB breakout, RSI divergence, volume spike, and EMA pullback) and only enters when at least 3 of 5 agree on direction AND none of the other 2 actively contradict. The adversarial validation means each sub-strategy tries to 'kill' the signal — if a mean reversion signal fires but the ORB is also breaking out in the opposite direction, the trade is vetoed. This ensemble approach dramatically reduces false positives. Edge persists because running 5 concurrent strategies with adversarial validation requires significant infrastructure and real-time computation.

indicators.name: orb_signal
indicators.formula: +1 if close > ORB_high; -1 if < ORB_low; 0 otherwise

indicators.name: divergence_signal
indicators.formula: +1 if bullish RSI divergence; -1 if bearish; 0 otherwise

indicators.name: volume_signal
indicators.formula: +1 if vol_spike AND green bar; -1 if vol_spike AND red bar; 0 otherwise

indicators.name: ema_signal
indicators.formula: +1 if pullback to EMA(20) in uptrend; -1 if pullback in downtrend; 0 otherwise

indicators.name: has_contradiction
indicators.formula: any signal is opposite to majority direction

long.confirmation: all conditions hold for 2 consecutive bars (persistence check)

short.confirmation: all conditions hold for 2 consecutive bars

entry.entry_price: market on second confirmation bar close

exit.signal_exit: ensemble_score drops below +2 (for longs) or rises above -2 (for shorts)

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.trend_filter: embedded in ema_signal and orb_signal sub-strategies
filters.event_filter: skip on stock result days, expiry day
other_filters: must hold for 2 consecutive bars to filter transient confluence

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — ensemble with adversarial validation is robust to individual strategy decay

weaknesses: Extremely low frequency — 5 strategies agreeing with no contradiction is very rare (maybe 2-3 times per week)
Implementation complexity is high — 5 concurrent strategy engines with real-time scoring
The sub-strategies can be correlated (e.g., VWAP mean reversion and RSI divergence often fire together), reducing true diversification of signals
2-bar persistence check adds ~2 bars of slippage to the entry
prior_art: Ensemble methods — common in ML but rare in rule-based trading. Adversarial validation is inspired by GAN architecture concepts applied to signal filtering.
notes: This is the 'crown jewel' strategy — highest expected edge but lowest frequency. Use as a high-conviction overlay on top of other strategies. Consider tracking each sub-strategy's individual performance to dynamically weight the ensemble score. Position sizing scaled to ensemble strength (3/5 vs 4/5 vs 5/5) is critical.
